(247)༄༅/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal karma pa'i zab chos sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gdams pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (247)༄༅// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal karma pa'i zab chos sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gdams pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(248)༄༅// spros bral chos dbyings bde chen dag pa'i ngang*// ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul ston// sna tshogs sprul skus 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// sku gsum bka' brgyud bla mar phyag byas nas// gdams ngag zab mo sku gsum sku bzhi yi// gnad don tshig nyung don tshang 'god par bya// de yang gang zag dbang po dman rnams la// sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bzhi ston pa ste// skyabs sems yig brgya maṇḍal la 'bad de// snang grags rtog gsum chos sku'i rang bzhin dang*// gsal stong 'dzin bral nyid du 'bad par bya// dbang po 'bring du gyur pa'i gang zag la// gnad bzhi chos nyid 'khor lo bskor ba ste// dang po bca' ba lus kyi gnad ston pa// btang snyoms rtsol sgrub med par skyil krung bca'// lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang*// bde zhing yangs dang lhod par bca' bar bya// gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor mos gus gnad// rang gi spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan steng*// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// sangs rgyas (249)kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las bsam mi khyab pa'i ngo bo la// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsgom// bla ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs rnams// bdag gi sgo gsum nyid la rab zhugs nas// mchog gi dngos grub thob par gsol ba 'debs// de ltar yang yang bsgom zhing 'bad par bya// mthar ni 'khor rnams 'od zhu bla mar thim// rdo rje 'chang nyid 'od zhu rang la bstim// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par bsam// de ltar rtse gcig legs par 'bad byas na// skyon dag yon tan ma lus rdzogs par 'gyur// gsum pa srog rtsol rlung gi gnad ston te// rlung zhes las kun byed pas gal gnad che// de nyid bsgom la lus gnad sngar bzhin te// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang nad gdon sel ba'i phyir// rlung ro lan gsum lhag ma med par dbyung*// de nas bum chen kha sbyor tshul bzhin 'dzin// rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med 'od gsal ba'i// ngang du ma yengs mnyam par bzhag par bya// rlung ni phyir 'bud dus su gzung 'dzin gyi// sdig sgrib dag (250)par bsam zhing yang yang 'bad// bzhi pa rtsol ba lus sbyong gnad ston te// lus kyi sgrib pa ma lus sbyong ba'i phyir// lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor sum bcu so bdun pa// brgya'am stong sogs mang du 'bad byas pas// ngal zhing dub tshe rig pa gang du yang*// mi 'phro sal le seng nge mnyam par bzhag

/de nas gnad bzhi'i rtsa ba gtum mo bsgom// de yang rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche bzhi gtsigs// phyag rgya lngas brgyan dbu skra sil bur grol// sku yi nang kun stong gsal dag pa'i dbus// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa gsal// lte bar raṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las// ye shes gtum mo mtshan nyid bzhi ldan bsgom// rlung bzung me de je cher gyur pa las// dbu ma'i nang dang ro rkyang rtsa 'dab kun// ye shes me yis chil gyis gang bar bsam// drug skor la sogs 'khrul 'khor la 'bad pas// me drod bskyed cing bde ba skye bar 'gyur// bde stong ngo bo bltas pas rang sar grol// 'di na rnam par mi rtog bskyed rim ste// zhib par khrid chen rnams su gsal bzhin no// dngos gzhi sku gsum ngo sprod tshul ston te// thog mar sprul pa'i sku ru ngo sprod pa// padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng*// bdag nyid bcom ldan shākya thub pa mchog /gser mdog chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan// mtshan bzang sum cu dpe byad brgyad cus spras// thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gis mtshan// srog rtsol rlung gi sbyor ba dang ldan pas// rlung gi nang du rngubs par byed pa'i tshe// sems can thams cad sprul sku shākya thub dang*// sangs rgyas stong sogs sprul pa'i sku ru gyur// rang gi sna dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// thams cad tshur 'dus dbu ma'i nang du thim// srog rtsol rlung sbyor phar la gtong ba'i (251)dus// sprul sku shākya thub bye ba grangs med 'phros// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad ltem gyis gang*// de dag kun gyis chos sgra cher sgrogs pas// 'gro ba thams cad shākya thub kho nar gyur// rlung ni nang du rngubs par gyur pa'i tshe// de dag thams cad tshur 'dus dbu mar thim// mi dmigs gsal stong ngang du mnyam par bzhag

/stong nyid ngang du snying rje tshad med bsgom// rig pa lte ba'i dbus su gtad par bya// de ltar yang nas yang du bsgom pa yis// chos kun sprul pa'i sku ru rtogs par gsung*// gdod nas 'gro kun sprul pa'i skur grub kyang*// ma rtogs tha mal 'khrul sems zhen pas bsgribs// bsgoms pas tha mal 'khrul pa kun sangs rgyas// snang srid sprul pa'i sku ru rtogs par gsung*// de nas longs spyod rdzogs skur sbyong ba'i thabs// padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng*// rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs spyan ras gzigs// 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa yi sku ru bsgom// thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig mthar// yi ge drug pas g.yas su bskor bar bsam// rlung gi sbyor ba phyi ru bus pa'i tshe// sna bug gnyis dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs du ma 'phros// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams khyab par 'phros// 'gro ba rigs drug bar dor bcas pa yi// sems can thams cad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sha stag gyur// rlung gi sbyor ba nang du rngubs pa'i tshe// de dag thams cad tshur 'dus rang la thim// dran rig ma bcos so ma'i ngang du bzhag /rang gi sku las 'od zer dpag med 'phros// rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing khams mchog rnams su// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur thams cad la// kun (252)bzang smon lam lta bu'i mchod pas mchod// thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur nas// rlung sbyor nang du rngubs dang lhan cig tu// thams cad tshur 'dus bdag la thim par bsam// gsal stong ngo bo'i steng du lhan ner bzhag /rig pa mgrin pa'i gnas su gtad par bya// de ltar yang yang nan tan bsgoms byas pas// rang bzhin gsal stong longs spyod rdzogs skur rtogs// yon tan dpag med rim gyis 'byung ba dang*// longs sku'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal mthong zhing*// rang nyid ma 'ongs longs spyod rdzogs sku yis// sems can rgya mtsho'i don byed nus pas 'gyur// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings las rang bzhin gsal// gsal stong zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs sku yi// rtogs pa yang dag shugs kyis 'char bar 'gyur// rang sems chos kyi sku ru ngo sprod pa// ma bcos gnyug ma lhun gyis grub pa ni// gang nas ma 'ong gang du mi 'gro zhing*// 'dus ma byas pa lhun gyis grub pa ni// 'gyur ba med pa chos kyi sku zhes brjod// tshig tu brjod dang dpe yis mtshon pa med// nam mkha'i dkyil du bltas pas mthong ba 'gags// sems kyis sems la yang yang blta byas na// rnam rtog tshogs rnams chu dang rlabs bzhin shes// rig pa gar yang mi 'phrog nas tsam na// chos kun stong pa nyid du go bar 'gyur// de ltar rtogs tshe 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// sems nyid kho na'i cho 'phrul nyid du go

/dran rtog thugs kyi khyer so bya ba dang*// dbu ma phyag chen rdzogs chen nyams len rnams// don gcig ming gi rnam grangs kho na nyid// dben gnas phyi ru mi btsal rang lus nyid// gzhal yas khang yin sems nyid skye med 'di// lha dang bla ma de las gzhan du med// gti mug zhe sdang (253)'dod chags nga rgyal dang*// phrag dog tshogs rnams ma spangs rang grol te// bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga nyid du nges// mdor na chos kun sems nyid kho na'i phyir// ma bcos rang sar bzhag pa'i sems nyid la// rnam rtog 'phro yang 'dzin med lhod der bzhag /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs// thams cad snang stong dbyer med kho nar grol// yod dang med ces bya ba'i mtha' dang bral// bsgom med yengs med dgag sgrub spang blang bral// bsgom zhes bya ba don la ma grub ste// ma yengs tsam du rang gar bor bas bde// gsal la mi rtog bde stong spros bral ba// rang rig rjen pa'i steng du ngo 'phrod na// dbang don lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te// 'bras bu chos sku zhes byar btags pa yin// de phyir snyan brgyud dri ma med pa 'di// blo ldan skal bzang rnams kyis spyod par rigs// de ltar sku gsum sku bzhi'i ngo sprod mdor bsdus pa tsam ste/ zhib pa ni bka' brgyud gong ma dag gi khrid yig rgyas 'bring du ma bzhugs pa rnams las rtogs par bya'o// 'di ni rtsa ba rje rang byung rdo rje'i gsung nyid la karma chags med rin po che'i zin bris bzhin bris pa ste/ 'jam mgon bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang po mchog gi bzhed skong du/ dpal karma pa'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs 'dzin pa dpal ldan rigs kun lhun grub theg mchog rdo rje nges don bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes 'bod pa'i snyoms las pas dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje sman dpal gyis skyong ba'i yul zla nang gi dben gnas dri bsung spos ngad ldan pa'i ljon shing gi nags tshal stug po'i dbus/

sgrub khang bkra shis rab brten gyi bsam gtan khang bur lam zab rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i thun mtshams su bris pas 'gro kun thams cad rnam mkhyen thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /maṅga lam/// / (254)
